```{python}
import inspect

from pypanelsim import core
```

## `PanelDimensions`

```{python}
print(inspect.signature(core.PanelDimensions))
```

`n_units` and `n_periods` must be positive integers. Every component draw uses
these dimensions.

## Component draws

| Type | Required values | Other fields |
|---|---|---|
| `ComponentDraw` | one `(unit, time)` matrix | metadata |
| `UnitFeatureDraw` | observed and latent `(unit, feature)` matrices | estimator-visible features, metadata, unit annotations |
| `TimeFeatureDraw` | one `(time, feature)` matrix | metadata, time annotations |

```{python}
for name in ("ComponentDraw", "UnitFeatureDraw", "TimeFeatureDraw"):
    print(name, inspect.signature(getattr(core, name)))
```

Draw objects are return values for custom components. They are not complete
panels.

## Component contexts

`AssignmentContext` contains dimensions, observed features, latent features,
and feature metadata.

`SimulationContext` adds the treatment matrix and optional time features. It is
passed to outcome and effect models.

```{python}
print(inspect.signature(core.AssignmentContext))
print(inspect.signature(core.SimulationContext))
```

## Component protocols

| Protocol | Required method | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `UnitFeatureModel` | `generate(dimensions, rng)` | `UnitFeatureDraw` |
| `AssignmentModel` | `assign(context, rng)` | `ComponentDraw` |
| `TimeFeatureModel` | `generate(dimensions, rng)` | `TimeFeatureDraw` |
| `OutcomeModel` | `generate(context, rng)` | `ComponentDraw` for $Y(0)$ |
| `EffectModel` | `generate(context, rng)` | realized effect plus `effect_surface` metadata |

Protocols use structural typing. A custom class can satisfy one without
inheritance.

## `PanelSimulator`

```{python}
print(inspect.signature(core.PanelSimulator))
print("simulate", inspect.signature(core.PanelSimulator.simulate))
print("iter_simulations", inspect.signature(core.PanelSimulator.iter_simulations))
```

Required constructor fields are:

- `name`: a nonempty design identifier;
- `dimensions`: one `PanelDimensions` value;
- `assignment`: an `AssignmentModel`;
- `outcome_model`: an `OutcomeModel`;
- `effect_model`: an `EffectModel` or compatible callable.

Feature models, custom unit and time identifiers, and axis annotations are
optional.

`simulate` accepts exactly one of `seed`, `rng`, or `streams`. It returns one
`PanelDataset`. `iter_simulations` spawns independent seed sequences and yields
the requested number of draws.

## `SimulationSeeds`

```{python}
print(inspect.signature(core.SimulationSeeds))
print(inspect.signature(core.SimulationSeeds.from_seed))
```

The five streams are `features`, `assignment`, `time_features`, `outcome`, and
`effect`. `from_seed` derives them from one NumPy `SeedSequence`.

## `resolve_rng`

```{python}
print(inspect.signature(core.resolve_rng))
```

This helper accepts a seed or an existing `numpy.random.Generator`, but not
both. Custom components normally receive an existing generator from the
simulator and do not call this helper.

## `PanelDataset`

```{python}
print(inspect.signature(core.PanelDataset))
```

### Stored matrices

All matrices are read-only and have the same `(unit, time)` shape.

| Field | Invariant |
|---|---|
| `outcome` | equals `untreated_outcome + treatment_effect` |
| `treatment` | contains only zero and one |
| `untreated_outcome` | finite untreated potential outcomes |
| `effect_surface` | complete cell effect if treated |
| `treatment_effect` | equals `effect_surface * treatment` |

### Properties

| Property | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `shape`, `n_units`, `n_periods` | dimensions |
| `ever_treated` | unit mask |
| `treated_units`, `control_units` | integer unit positions |
| `is_absorbing` | treatment never switches off |
| `adoption_times` | first treatment position; `n_periods` for controls |
| `true_att` | mean realized effect over treated cells |
| `truth` | a `PanelTruth` view |
| `counterfactual_target_mask` | treated cells whose $Y(0)$ is hidden |

### Conversion methods

```{python}
for name in ("as_arrays", "arrays", "as_long_dict"):
    print(name, inspect.signature(getattr(core.PanelDataset, name)))
```

`as_arrays()` returns outcome and treatment. `arrays(fields)` returns selected
matrices. `as_long_dict()` returns columns for data-frame construction. Pass
`include_effect_surface=True` or `include_annotations=True` only when those
columns are needed.

## `PanelTruth`

```{python}
for name in ("cohort_event", "event_study", "att_by_cohort"):
    print(name, inspect.signature(getattr(core.PanelTruth, name)))
```

- `cohort_event(event_times)` returns supported cohort-by-event-time cells.
- `event_study(event_times, weighting=...)` aggregates over supported cohorts.
- `att_by_cohort()` returns a treated-cell ATT for each adoption cohort.

The weighting options are `cohort_size` and `equal_cohort`. Unsupported
cohort-event cells remain explicit and are never silently treated as zeros.
